data.name: Shekar
data.long_meaning: The name Shekar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shikhar', which means 'Lord of the Mountains'. It is a powerful and strong name, associated with prosperity and abundance. In Hindu mythology, Shiva, the god of destruction, is often depicted as residing on the mountain Kailash. As such, the name Shekar is a tribute to the divine power and strength of the mountains.
